_preregistration.rung: the raw arm must reproduce argmax_census_hardened exactly at both seeds
_preregistration.primary: does ANY arm on ANY base model move UP beyond its own seed noise
_preregistration.falsifier: a single robust up-shift falsifies F151's unidirectional claim and forces another revision of paper 2's thesis -- that is the outcome that would matter most
_preregistration.lengths_rationale: no chat template exists for base models, so both extremes of the measured instruct template lengths are used (gemma 9, Qwen2.5 29) rather than one arbitrary choice
_preregistration.limitation: base models have no chat template, the arm with the largest effect in F151, so this extends the DIRECTION claim only
_preregistration.why: F151 is paper 2's headline and rests on two models; eight mid-range base models were already censused by F143, so the screen is free and the cohort is the one the whole programme rests on
